title: Trees And Plants 6th Degree Summary Declaration Of Divine Unity

questions.question: What kinds of living things are talked about in this passage?
questions.answer: Trees and plants.

questions.question: What do all the kinds of trees and plants agree on?
questions.answer: They all point to Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: What parts of trees and plants are described like they are speaking?
questions.answer: Their leaves, flowers, and fruits.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the gifts given through plants?
questions.answer: They are given with care, kindness, and purpose.

questions.question: What does it mean that plants are made in many different kinds and shapes?
questions.answer: Allah makes them different on purpose, with wisdom.

questions.question: Where do many of these different plant forms begin?
questions.answer: From seeds and grains.

questions.question: How are those seeds and grains described at the start?
questions.answer: They are alike or very close alike, and they are limited in number.

questions.question: What is amazing about plants coming from similar seeds?
questions.answer: Many different beautiful forms come from seeds that look much the same.

questions.question: What is one main lesson of the whole passage?
questions.answer: All kinds of trees and plants are signs of Allah.

questions.question: Who alone is named as worthy of worship in this passage?
questions.answer: Allah alone.

questions.question: What group in nature gives a united witness here?
questions.answer: All species of trees and plants.

questions.question: How do the leaves help give this witness?
questions.answer: By their order and balance.

questions.question: How do the flowers help give this witness?
questions.answer: By their beauty and lovely form.

questions.question: How do the fruits help give this witness?
questions.answer: By being well-made and well-arranged.

questions.question: What three gift words are used in meaning for what is given through plants?
questions.answer: Blessing, kindness, and generosity.

questions.question: Are these gifts said to happen without meaning, or with mercy and purpose?
questions.answer: With mercy and purpose.

questions.question: What does the passage say about making plants different from one another?
questions.answer: It is done by will and wisdom.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention both similar seeds and many different plants?
questions.answer: To show that big variety can come from simple beginnings by Allah’s will.

questions.question: What is the big message repeated in this passage?
questions.answer: Allah is One.

questions.question: Which living things are said to praise and glorify Allah?
questions.answer: All kinds of trees and plants.

questions.question: What are three parts of plants used as signs in the passage?
questions.answer: Leaves, flowers, and fruits.

questions.question: How are the leaves described in meaning?
questions.answer: They are balanced and clear signs.

questions.question: How are the flowers described in meaning?
questions.answer: They are pretty and full.

questions.question: How are the fruits described in meaning?
questions.answer: They are orderly and meaningful.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about beauty in plants?
questions.answer: Their beauty is made on purpose.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the many plant kinds in the world?
questions.answer: Their differences are made with wisdom.

questions.question: What starts the opening of all these many plant forms?
questions.answer: Seeds and grains.

questions.question: Is the passage about rocks and birds, or about trees and plants?
questions.answer: It is about trees and plants.

questions.question: Do the trees and plants give mixed messages, or do they agree together?
questions.answer: They agree together.

questions.question: What truth do they agree on?
questions.answer: That Allah exists and is One.

questions.question: What shows careful giving in the plant world?
questions.answer: The many blessings and gifts in it.

questions.question: What shows mercy in the plant world?
questions.answer: These gifts are given kindly and with care.

questions.question: What shows wisdom in the plant world?
questions.answer: Plants are made in many fitting forms and kinds.

questions.question: Why is it important that the forms are described as balanced and decorated?
questions.answer: It shows they are made carefully, not carelessly.

questions.question: What comparison is made between the seeds and the plant forms that come from them?
questions.answer: The seeds are similar, but the forms that grow from them are many and different.

questions.question: What does this difference between similar seeds and many plant forms help prove?
questions.answer: It helps prove Allah’s wisdom and power.

questions.question: What is the passage asking us to notice in nature?
questions.answer: The signs of Allah in every kind of plant.

questions.question: What does the passage say all plant species do together?
questions.answer: They give one shared testimony.

questions.question: To whom is this testimony pointing?
questions.answer: To Allah.

questions.question: Which plant part can remind us of order when we look at it?
questions.answer: The leaves.

questions.question: Which plant part can remind us of beauty and decoration?
questions.answer: The flowers.

questions.question: Which plant part can remind us of arrangement and benefit?
questions.answer: The fruits.

questions.question: What does the passage say about giving blessings through plants?
questions.answer: It is done on purpose and with mercy.

questions.question: What does the passage say about making one plant unlike another?
questions.answer: It is done with will and wisdom.

questions.question: What are the first small things mentioned before many plant forms appear?
questions.answer: Seeds and grains.

questions.question: Are those starting seeds described as endless or limited?
questions.answer: Limited.

questions.question: What natural world is the focus of this passage?
questions.answer: The world of trees and plants.

questions.question: What are trees and plants shown doing in a special way?
questions.answer: Glorifying Allah and pointing to Him.

questions.question: Name one way leaves give that message.
questions.answer: They show balance and order.

questions.question: Name one way flowers give that message.
questions.answer: They show beauty and adornment.

questions.question: Name one way fruits give that message.
questions.answer: They show good order and clear purpose.

questions.question: What two heart-warming ideas are joined with Allah’s giving in the passage?
questions.answer: Mercy and generosity.

questions.question: What two mind-teaching ideas are joined with the many kinds of plants?
questions.answer: Will and wisdom.

questions.question: Why does the passage talk about forms that are many, different, and beautiful?
questions.answer: To show that Allah creates with knowledge and care.

questions.question: What is the best short summary of the passage?
questions.answer: All trees and plants are clear signs of Allah’s oneness.
